title: Validate metric_name and kwargs before import_module in third-party scorer deserialization
answers: dotted metric name in scorer payload imports a module
scorer kwargs metric_name overrides the registry lookup
RagasScorer or DeepEvalScorer imports an arbitrary path from a crafted payload
body:
Symptom: a crafted third-party scorer payload makes RagasScorer or DeepEvalScorer import a caller-placed module, even when the module itself is allow-listed.
Root cause: the wrappers splice unknown metric_name values into import paths (ragas.metrics.collections.<metric_name>, deepeval.metrics.<metric_name>Metric). Concrete subclasses inherit the wrapper __init__, so a metric_name in kwargs reached the constructor unchecked (mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate).
Fix pattern: in Scorer.model_validate, reject metric_name that is not str.isidentifier(), and reject any kwargs containing 'metric_name'. Both checks run before importlib.import_module. Tests assert import_module is never called.
Constraints: the deserializer injects metric_name only when the class has no metric_name ClassVar, so the top-level value is the only trusted source. Keep these checks ahead of the import.
applies: Changes to Scorer.model_validate or to RagasScorer/DeepEvalScorer metric-name resolution in mlflow/genai/scorers.
says: A crafted third-party scorer configuration allows loading unapproved modules during model evaluation.
Evaluation metric definitions accept invalid names and load unintended external code libraries.
Block unauthorized code loading by strictly validating metric names before running evaluations.
Reject custom scorer configurations that pass unexpected arguments or invalid metric naming.
search: In third-party scorer deserialization within mlflow/genai/scorers, Scorer.model_validate must validate metric_name with str.isidentifier() and reject kwargs containing metric_name before calling importlib.import_module. This prevents crafted payloads for RagasScorer or DeepEvalScorer from splicing unchecked metric_name values into import paths like ragas.metrics.collections or deepeval.metrics to load caller-placed modules. Deserialization injects metric_name only when the class lacks a metric_name ClassVar, making the top-level value the only trusted source. Applies to changes in mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate, mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES, or metric-name resolution for Ragas and DeepEval scorers.
